title: Connect the power supply and activate Pro-finder
body_md: Once the card is inserted and the holder is locked, connect the power supply. The status LED then flashes red briefly and afterwards yellow-green. The source recommends carrying out the activation with the app, which guides through the individual steps.
prev_context: Before this stands the omitted way to obtain the app.
next_context: The source then describes activation without the app.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 14: the colour sequence matches. The additional claim that the app makes sections 2.5 to 2.8 unnecessary is not carried over as an operating path while DSC-043 is open. The English sentence carrying that claim also contains a typing error (“will be not be required”), which is corrected here rather than reproduced.
